prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” agent for every seller — the right agent depends on your neighborhood, price range, timeline and priorities. I can help you find the best fit. To get started, it helps to know a few things:

Quick questions
- What is the address (or at least the Pleasanton neighborhood / zip) and estimated price range?
- What’s your ideal timeline to sell?
- Any preferences: large brokerage vs boutique, full-service marketing, discount/flat-fee, experience with luxury homes, bilingual agent, etc.?

How to identify the best agent for your house
- Track record in your neighborhood and price range (recent comparable sales they listed and sold).
- List-to-sale price ratio and average days-on-market (DOM) for their listings.
- Marketing plan: professional photography, drone/twilight photos, virtual tours, targeted online ads, broker outreach, social media, email campaigns.
- Negotiation results and experience handling contingencies/inspections.
- Client reviews and references (ask for 2–3 recent seller references).
- Responsiveness, communication style, and availability.
- Fees and net-proceeds estimate (get a written net sheet showing expected closing proceeds).
- Staging and prep support (do they coordinate stagers/contractors/photographers?).

Where to look
- Local MLS reports / RealTrends lists for top producers.
- Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com (agent profiles, recent sales, reviews).
- Google and Yelp reviews.
- Nextdoor and local Facebook groups for neighborhood referrals.
- Ask neighbors who recently sold — local word-of-mouth is often best.

What to ask when you interview agents (interview 3–4)
- How many homes like mine have you sold in Pleasanton in the past 12 months?
- Can you show 3 recent comparable listings and the final sale prices?
- What is your suggested listing price and why? Can you provide a CMA?
- What is your marketing plan and estimated marketing budget?
- What is your commission and any extra fees? Are you open to a performance-based structure?
- How will you communicate progress and showings? Who will I work with day-to-day?
- Provide 2–3 recent seller references I can contact.
- What do you do to maximize sale price and reduce days on market?

If you want, I can:
- Pull a short list (3–5) of top-performing agents in Pleasanton based on recent sales and reviews if you give me your address or neighborhood, or
- Draft an email/script you can send to potential agents and a comparison checklist to use after interviews.

Which option would you prefer?
